body_html:
Ken, a seasoned DJ hailing from Cleveland, Ohio, has been spinning tracks and creating unforgettable moments since 2015. His journey began with crafting mixtapes and energizing club events, quickly expanding to cover a wide range of occasions, including weddings, mitzvahs, school dances, and corporate events. Ken thrives on crowd interaction, bringing energy and joy to every event he touches.

A devoted family man, Ken is married with children and balances his love for DJing with a passion for carpentry. His musical palette is vast, ranging from Hip Hop, R&B, and Neo-Soul to Pop, Reggae, Jazz, and Country, ensuring he can cater to any audience’s tastes. Outside of music, Ken enjoys watching sports, cooking, and spending quality time with his loved ones.

Ken’s deep commitment to his craft is evident in every performance. His outgoing personality, combined with a professional approach, allows him to create lasting memories for clients. Whether you’re planning a wedding, mitzvah, corporate event, or school dance, Ken brings integrity, pride, and professionalism to ensure your event is nothing short of spectacular.
